item.title: Version 0.5.0
item.description: Models you don't own, if you want them: a Cloud tab for bring-your-own-key providers — GMI Cloud (MiniMax M3 and M2.7, plus speech and music), OpenRouter, and NVIDIA's free developer tier. Off until you add a key, and never picked for you: your agents still fall back to a local model unless you choose otherwise. OpenMontage, the open-source agentic video studio, gets a Set up button in Settings — one click installs it to ~/OpenMontage and links this app in as a $0 provider for images, video and 3D, so its productions render on your Mac and your swarm. Qwen Code's daemon now starts with a bearer token, so adding a workspace works. Silicon Node gets its own download and section on the site.
